QUOTE: "`schema`, stamped older than the server: rebuild with `force=True`. Stamped newer: rebuilding cannot clear it, so restart the MCP client. - `code`: reads are fine but writes are unsafe, so restart the client. A rebuild cannot fix it."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says data needs refresh and code needs a client restart, but never argues that distinct clearing actions are the reason one flag would not have been enough.
